answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7018 Country: India Title: I just want to know the meaning of my name "RABIA JEHAN".and also the meaning of "ASIA". Question: assalamualaikum I just want to know the meaning of my name "RABIA JEHAN".and also the meaning of "ASIA". Answer ID: 7018 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1018/899=L/1429) Rabia means: fourth. Rabia Basriah was a well-known pious woman. Jehan (meaning: world) is suffixed with names. Aasia was the name of the wife of Pharaoh, she believed in Hadhrat Musa ( علیہ السلام ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
